reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the strength–ductility trade-off in eutectic HEAs with a physically sound, phase-selective recrystallization mechanism, is specific and testable with a clear baseline and falsification experiment, and is well-grounded by cited evidence showing ~35% uniform elongation and ~2 GPa true stress; Hypothesis B lacks cited support, proposes a generic precipitation mechanism without explaining how it simultaneously improves ductility, and includes an unjustified specific value (~20% improvement).
